request.text: What is the voltage on R1?

solution.item: *** Solution by TINA assisted by AI ***
At first we calculate the total resistance between the generator nodes (VS1)
R4 and R3 connected in series so Rc=R4+R3=1Ohm+1Ohm=2Ohm
R2 and Rc connected in parallel so Rb=R2 * Rc / (R2+Rc)=2Ohm*2Ohm / (2Ohm+2Ohm)=1Ohm
Rb and R1 connected in series so Ra=Rb+R1=1Ohm+1Ohm=2Ohm
Now we calculate the voltage on R1
We know that the voltage between VS1 nodes is 5 Volt.
The components Rb,R1 connected in series.
The voltage between this components starting and ending node is 5 Volt
R1 is in the voltage divider so the voltage on R1 is R1 / Ra * 5 Volt = 2.5 Volt
